Hydrogen mediator, heat and service-cost contracts
ROOT independent physical calculations,12November2026Brisbane

Useful boundary
Water-to-delivered dry pressurizedH2 is a full operation including electrodes/carrier, gas acceptance, drying/compression, thermal state, preparation, replacement and shutdown. The underlying complete-ammonia ledger is not a demonstration of a new hydrogen module.
In the available conditional ammonia design,11.5->10kWh/kg saves only0.075USD/kg at0.05USD/kWh. Waiving its0.505USD/kg initial capital recovery leaves0.998USD/kg with its other costs unchanged; capital is therefore material, but no free factory/life follows.

Actually read component precedent
The initial main pp786--789 of Dotan etal2019 E-TAC, DOI10.1038/s41560-019-0462-7, describe cobalt-doped nickel-hydroxide electrochemical charging with hydrogen evolution and hotter chemical regeneration with oxygen release. Small100s/100s cycles used ambient/95C alkaline baths and a platinized benchmark cathode. Reported low cell work is electrical-only. This supplies a real separated-reaction operation, not complete heat recovery, pressurized gas handling, lifetime or plant cost.
The exact authorPDF https://canli.dicp.ac.cn/hqq.pdf subsequently failed BOTH first governing heat/Methods finds with400Timeout. SAME paper identity is HELD against further lookup/alternate/provider/version/www normalization/title/SI/export. Full heat/methods/plant claims remain unread; only the initial component passages retain their scope. No98.7%voltage ratio is treated as complete-system efficiency.

At INTRODUCED1.50V mean terminal voltage,99.5%net charge yield and96%rectification, AC electricity is41.7562kWh/kg before other work.
For a low-pressure source, ideal isothermal1-to30bar compression at298.15K divided by INTRODUCED65%efficiency costs1.78739kWh/kg. Only1.45640kWh/kg remains below45 for all heat, purification, pumps, controls and other work. If terminal voltage already pays pressure generation, do not add that compression again. This uses an ideal gas model, not a held NIST-H2 thermochemical table.
